brief:
A UK antisemitism report risks teaching Jewish pupils that support for Israel is central to their identity, according to analysis by Middle East Eye. The concern centers on how the report's framing could inadvertently strengthen the association between Jewish identity and Israeli state politics, potentially deepening divisions rather than resolving them.

Critics argue the approach may also present Palestine solidarity advocacy as inherently antisemitic, conflating criticism of Israeli policy with prejudice against Jewish people. Such conflation could marginalize voices within Jewish communities that distinguish between antisemitism and legitimate Palestinian rights activism.

title: UK antisemitism report may reinforce Israel-identity link, critics warn
